messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing. They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask: "計算...的標準差" maybe they want the standard error? Or they want the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard error of the mean under null? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" could be "standard deviation of the test statistic" which is sqrt(σ^2/n). But we don't know population sigma. They gave sample sigma 1.4. For t-test, we use sample std dev. So standard error = sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). sqrt(40)=6.3249. So SE=0.2213. Then t-statistic = (sample_mean - population_mean)/SE = (98.2-98.6)/0.2213 = -0.4/0.2213 = -1.807. Then p-value two-tailed: 2*P(T > |t|). For df=39. Let's approximate using t distribution. t=1.807, df=39. Using approximate p-value: For df=40, t=1.68 gives p=0.10; t=2.02 gives p=0.05. So t=1.807 gives p ~0.08. So p-value ~0.08. So we cannot reject null at alpha=0.05. So answer: standard error 0.221, t-statistic -1.81, p-value ~0.08. Provide explanation.
